label: Air-source heat pump
description: Air-source heat pump (ASHP). Computes electricity input and annual tCO2e from delivered heat.

inputs.label: Annual heat delivered
inputs.help: Total thermal heat delivered over a year (space heating and/or hot water as applicable).

inputs.label: Heat pump COP
inputs.help: Coefficient of performance (heat out / electricity in).

inputs.label: Electricity carbon intensity
inputs.help: Grid carbon intensity used to convert kWh into emissions.
